# Codex subset patch ledger

Pinned reference revision: `28f3f1f9ef4e9578a5f023f6b6eba018914a5342`.

Minha independently implements behavior-compatible adapters for device OAuth,
token refresh, model discovery, Responses API request/SSE items, and read-only
rate-limit headers. The implementation is smaller and Minha-specific; no
upstream source file is copied verbatim. When source is imported, record its
path and local changes below.
